```
        icon={<PaperclipIcon />}
        hasAdd={true}
        collapsible={true}
        emptyState="No files yet, drag some here"
        dropTarget={true}
      />
      <Widget
        title="Collaborators"
        icon={<GroupIcon />}
        hasAdd={true}
        collapsible={true}
        emptyState="No collaborators"
      />
      <KeyboardNavHint
        text="Press → to view next lead or ← to view previous lead"
      />
    </RightSidebar>

  </ThreeColumnLayout>

  <GettingStartedBar
    completed={2}
    total={7}
    onContinue={navigateToOnboarding}
    onDismiss={dismissBar}
  />

  <HelpButton />
</PersonDetailPage>
```

### Non-Obvious Logic

1. **Agent profile card in timeline:** The Matt Ryan profile/signature card rendered at the top of the center column appears to be an email signature card injected into automated campaign emails. FUB likely stores an agent's email signature as a rich-HTML block and renders it inline within the timeline when viewing the email content. The card is NOT a separate UI component of the person record header — it is the body of an email.

2. **"archived" email subject:** The word "archived" shown as email content likely means these campaign emails have been archived in the email system (e.g., Gmail archive). FUB shows the current status of the email thread. The actual email subject line may differ; "archived" may be a status label applied when FUB marks emails as archived to avoid inbox clutter.

3. **Pixel tracking URL format:** The `?_pxl=` query parameter contains a base64-encoded token that identifies: person ID, campaign ID, email ID, and agent ID. The decoded format appears to follow `djox...` base64 prefix. Each email in the campaign has a unique token.

4. **Open count badges:** FUB tracks email opens via a 1×1 tracking pixel embedded in each campaign email. The count increments each time the pixel is loaded. A badge reading "2 opens" means the pixel fired twice (could be 1 person opening twice, or 2 different clients/devices).

5. **"via automation" label:** Distinguishes machine-sent emails (via automation/action plan) from manually composed emails. This is important for filtering and reporting on automation effectiveness vs. manual outreach.

6. **Widget "(1)" badge on Automations header:** The count in the header title ("Automations (1)") reflects the number of active automation enrollments, not total historical enrollments. This count decrements when an automation completes or is stopped.

7. **Keyboard navigation:** The `→` / `←` shortcut navigates within the current list context (smart list, search results, or inbox queue). The application must maintain a cursor/index into the current result set so it knows which person is "next" and "previous."

8. **Person ID in URL:** The ID (27022) is the primary key for the `people` table. The `/2/` prefix in the URL path is the FUB account/workspace ID (or API version prefix — likely workspace ID since FUB supports multiple sub-accounts).

9. **Right sidebar widget collapse state:** Each widget has an independent collapse/expand state. This state is [INFERRED] persisted server-side per user (not just browser localStorage) so the user's preferred layout persists across sessions and devices.

10. **"Getting Started" bar dismissal:** The dark "×" button on the left of the bottom bar allows dismissal. The bar is a persistent onboarding nudge shown until all 7 steps are completed. The fraction ("2 of 7") and the "Continue Getting Started" button suggest a guided multi-step onboarding flow with a progress checklist view.
